chart_data_needs.title: Projected Annual Revenue and Break-Even Timeline for Heavy-Lifter v2 vs Swift-Class
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Which fleet configuration achieves profitability faster and by what margin?
required_metrics: Heavy-Lifter v2: annual revenue ($M), annual operating cost ($M), cumulative profit ($M)
Swift-Class: annual revenue ($M), annual operating cost ($M), cumulative profit ($M)
search_queries: drone delivery revenue per drone per year 2025
heavy lifter drone operating cost per flight hour 2024
Swift-class drone cost per delivery 2024
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use public data from company filings or industry benchmarks. If only two data points exist, estimate intermediate years using CAGR from market growth forecasts and mark as estimates.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Provide financial justification for fleet selection by comparing cumulative revenue and cost trajectories over time.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: The financial viability of each fleet option depends on when cumulative revenue surpasses cumulative costs. We need to compare break-even timelines.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Heavy-Lifter v2 breaks even in 18 months, 6 months earlier than Swift-Class, making it the more financially prudent choice.

comparison_set: Our two fleets vs top competitors

chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use publicly disclosed cost data or credible estimates from analysts. If exact cost not available, use range and note source.
